text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek defeats Oguri Cap and<n>Tamamo Cross
to win the Arima<n>Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the post-race interview, she<n>reflects on our
hardships and how<n>those trials have helped us
grow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She tells the reporters that for her<n>next goal, she
would like to take part<n>in a race she has always
dreamed<n>of—the Osaka Hai.
